title: Toggle panel
description: A settings panel whose switches a pointer turns on one by one: each knob slides, the track fills with the accent and the header's count ticks up; after a beat the header turns to its done state (check + accent). For security/privacy features, 'set it once' onboarding and SaaS feature lists. Over video by default.

default: +Single sign-on: Everyone signs in with the team account
Review before publish: A second person approves each change
Watermark drafts: Shared links show a draft mark
Lock brand kit: Logos and fonts can't be swapped
rows.description: One per switch as 'Label: detail' (the detail is optional). Start a row with + to show it already on; the pointer switches the others on, top to bottom.

done.description: What the header's count becomes once every switch is on.

cursor.description: Show the pointer clicking each switch (false: the switches flip by themselves).
